topic: Diabetes Awareness Month: everyday care habits
headline: Diabetes care:
intro: November is Diabetes Awareness Month. These small habits can make everyday diabetes care easier.

points.title: Keep a simple log
points.body: Write down your readings so you and your healthcare team can spot patterns over time.

points.title: Check your supplies
points.body: Test strips have an expiry date. Keep them in their closed container, away from heat and moisture.
points.tip: Check the date on every new box.

points.title: Look after your feet
points.body: Check your feet every day for cuts, blisters or redness, and tell your healthcare team about changes.

points.title: Review your medications
points.body: A MedsCheck is a one-on-one review of your medications with a pharmacist.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
